tours.title: Burj Khalifa At the Top: Skip-the-Line Ticket (Level 124 & 125)
tours.abstract: Skip the queues and ascend to the observation decks of the world's tallest building. Enjoy breathtaking 360° views of the Dubai skyline, the desert, and the Arabian Gulf from Level 124 and 125.
tours.description: The Burj Khalifa stands at 828 metres and dominates the Dubai skyline. Your skip-the-line ticket grants you fast-track access to the At the Top experience on Levels 124 and 125. High-speed elevators take you to the top in under a minute. Interactive multimedia displays tell the story of Dubai's transformation. The outdoor terrace offers unobstructed panoramic views. Telescopes on the deck let you zoom in on landmarks across the city.
tours.additional_information: Tickets are timed entry — arrive within your allocated 30-minute window. Smart casual dress code applies. The attraction may close temporarily during adverse weather.
highlights: 360° views of Dubai, the desert, and the Arabian Gulf
High-speed elevator to the top in under a minute
Interactive multimedia displays on Dubai's history
tours.inclusions:
• Skip-the-line ticket to Burj Khalifa Level 124 & 125
• Access to outdoor observation terrace
• Multimedia guide included
tours.exclusions:
Hotel transfers
At the Top SKY (Level 148) — available as upgrade

cancellation_policy.cancellation_policy_text: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts.

tours.title: Dubai Desert Safari with Dune Bashing, Camel Ride & BBQ Dinner
tours.abstract: Experience the thrill of dune bashing in a 4x4, ride a camel at sunset, try sandboarding, and enjoy a lavish BBQ dinner under the stars with live entertainment in a traditional Bedouin camp.
tours.description: Afternoon pick-up from your Dubai hotel in a 4WD vehicle. Head to the red sand dunes of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve for an exhilarating dune bashing session. Watch the sunset from the top of a dune, then transfer to a traditional Bedouin camp. Activities at the camp include camel riding, sandboarding, falconry displays, henna painting, and a shisha lounge. Enjoy an unlimited BBQ buffet with grilled meats, mezze, and traditional Arabic sweets. Live entertainment includes a Tanoura whirling dance show and a belly dance performance. Return transfer to your hotel by 22:30.
tours.additional_information: Dune bashing is not recommended for pregnant women, people with back or neck problems, or those with heart conditions. Dress modestly when visiting the camp. Pick-up time is between 15:00 and 16:00 depending on your hotel location.
not_suitable_for: People with back or neck problems
highlights: Dune bashing in a 4WD through red sand dunes
Tanoura dance and belly dance shows
tours.inclusions:
• Return hotel transfers
• Dune bashing in 4WD
• Camel ride
• Sandboarding
• BBQ buffet dinner
• Soft drinks, water, tea, coffee
• Live entertainment
tours.exclusions:
Alcoholic beverages (available for purchase)
Professional photos

cancellation_policy.cancellation_policy_text: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the experience starts.

tours.title: Dubai Frame: Entry Ticket with Sky Bridge Walk
tours.abstract: Visit the iconic Dubai Frame, a 150-metre picture frame-shaped structure bridging old and new Dubai. Walk the glass-floored sky bridge for views of Deira on one side and Downtown Dubai on the other.
tours.description: The Dubai Frame stands 150 metres tall in Zabeel Park and frames the old and new parts of the city perfectly. The lower floors host an immersive museum chronicling Dubai's transformation from a small fishing village to a global metropolis. A high-speed elevator takes you to the sky bridge, where a retractable glass floor gives you a vertigo-inducing view straight down to the park below. The upper walkway offers simultaneous views of historic Deira and modern Downtown Dubai — the perfect metaphor built into the architecture itself.
tours.additional_information: Tickets are timed entry. The glass floor section can be bypassed for visitors uncomfortable with heights. Allow approximately 45–60 minutes for the full experience.
not_allowed: Food and drinks inside the frame
not_suitable_for: Visitors with severe vertigo or acrophobia
highlights: Glass-floored sky bridge 150m above the ground
Views of both old Deira and modern Downtown Dubai
tours.inclusions:
• Entry ticket to Dubai Frame
• Sky bridge access
• Museum access
tours.exclusions:
Transport to/from the venue
Zabeel Park entry fee

cancellation_policy.cancellation_policy_text: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts.

tours.title: Old Dubai Walking Tour: Al Fahidi, Spice Souk & Gold Souk
tours.abstract: Explore the historic heart of Dubai on foot with a local guide. Walk through the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood, cross the Creek by abra, and browse the aromatic Spice Souk and glittering Gold Souk.
tours.description: Begin in the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood, one of Dubai's oldest surviving areas, with its wind-tower architecture and narrow alleyways. Visit the Dubai Museum inside the Al Fahidi Fort. Take a traditional abra (water taxi) across the Dubai Creek to Deira. Stroll through the covered Spice Souk — the air thick with cardamom, saffron, and frankincense. Continue to the Gold Souk, where over 300 jewellers display some of the world's largest collections of gold jewellery. Your guide will share stories of the pearl diving era and Dubai's trading history throughout.
tours.additional_information: Wear comfortable closed-toe shoes — the tour involves 3–4km of walking on uneven surfaces. Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered). Abra crossing included.
not_suitable_for: Wheelchair users (narrow alleyways and ferry boarding)
highlights: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood & Dubai Museum
Abra water taxi across Dubai Creek
tours.inclusions:
• Expert English-speaking guide
• Abra (water taxi) crossing
• Dubai Museum entry
• Small group (max 12)
tours.exclusions:
Personal shopping
Food and drinks
Hotel transfers
